text:
Marta: quick Q — with the PTO accrual cutover on Jul 1, how are we handling carryover caps for folks in APAC whose local holidays overlap the Sep product-launch blackout? Need to advise our eng team asap. :wave:
Luca: is this the change that drops carryover from 80h to 48h?
people-ops: yep — starting Jul 1 the official carryover cap becomes 48h and accrual cadence adjusts. Blackout for the launch (Sep 18-25) is 'core coverage recommended'; PTO is allowed but requires manager pre-approval for coverage reasons. Link to draft policy in the handbook: https://intranet.redwood/policies/pto
Ravi: what is the process for exceptions? I have ~32h that would be affected and I also need to be off for a local holiday that week.
people-ops: file a "Carryover exception" via the HR form and attach manager sign-off. We evaluate exceptions for conflicts with mandatory coverage or regional public holidays. Approvals are granted case-by-case.
Ava: other nuance — new hires who joined this quarter: are accruals prorated? APAC payroll sometimes does weird rounding, want to set expectations.
people-ops: yes, accruals are prorated in the start month. If someone joins after the cutoff for accruals in a month, we prorate for that partial month. For carryover limits, we use the balance at the cutoff date.
hr-bot: Policy doc updated (automated): https://intranet.redwood/policies/pto — summary included in the comment thread.
Marta: can you paste a manager-approval template we can forward to leads? saves back-and-forth. :pray:
people-ops: manager approval template (short): "I approve a carryover exception for [employee name]: reason = [coverage/holiday conflict], hours = [X], approval period = [date range]. Manager: [name]"
Luca: perfect, I'll send that to my manager now.
EJ: side Q — if someone is on unpaid leave during the cutoff month, do they lose accruals or carryover eligibility?
people-ops: unpaid leave pauses accruals for the duration of leave; carryover eligibility uses the balance at cutoff. If leave caused someone to lose eligibility we can review on appeal. Quick policy snippet:
```
Carryover cap = min(48h, previous_balance)
Accruals paused during unpaid leave
Exceptions require manager sign-off and People Ops review
```
Ava: thanks — will include this guidance in the team sync notes. :thumbsup:
Marta: appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll collect any exception forms and tag @people-ops when I need a review.
